## Requirements (from the contract)

1. Implement only the owner-bound slice tested by AC-1 and AC-2, with
   admitted durable/wire compatibility and reuse of lower-layer
   codecs/stores: the O6 reservation-refusal cell (real Account, zero
   remaining model_calls, identical positive transport path), the O7
   exhaustion/drain cell (committed effect behind a bounded barrier,
   actual time.wall_ms reaching the Account bound, block new dispatch,
   drain to observed/unknown, exhaustion/stop, no later marker), and
   the fixed 8×3 seeded-permutation/stage-count report machinery
   (P→A→R→T, V, A/P·R/A·T/R·V/T with zero-denominator undefined,
   [V/P,(V+U)/P] missingness bound, O8 detected/3 separate, retained
   outcome kinds, one setup diagnostic rerun per cell new identity).
2. Retain the regression/evidence and per-target acceptance mapping
   under `docs/build/runs/R5.34.md` and its PR record; index only
   actual results.
3. Consume predecessor contracts unchanged. A new shared/persisted
   decision belongs in the owning ADR admission, not an
   implementation-local substitute.

## Acceptance criteria (from the contract)

- [ ] AC-1 (D/E; positive): zero model_calls on the positive transport
  path + persistent wall expiry after committed-effect barrier;
  fixture fixed 8×3 permutation/report machinery preserves P/A/R/T,
  V/T, bounds and O8 separate sensitivity.
- [ ] AC-2 (D/E; negative): dispatch on reserve refusal, expiry before
  commit, later marker, duplicate charge, missing detector, zero
  denominator, replaced original or excess setup retry fails. Real
  24-trial proof is the gated execution owner's; fixtures cannot
  close it.
- [ ] AC-3 (D/E; ownership and evidence): contributing REQs resolved
  to numbered checks + actual evidence in coverage register; achieved
  D/E separate from owed R/P or actual-execution E; no full-target
  claim (primary owner R5.44).
- [ ] AC-4 (E/D; scoped verification): fails-without regression;
  `cargo fmt --all --check` + owning-package tests; drift/
  removability/CI-mode checks when touched (restore default helper);
  exact commands + counts; scratch stores.
- [ ] AC-5 (D/E; universal phase gate): green in scope; REQ ids
  stamped; DEFERRALS rows for owed; ADRs for owned decisions;
  run/PR/BUILD_INDEX/LEDGER agree; operating clauses; ≤2KiB phase
  log; no deferred full-target predicate becomes MET.
